reviews.text: Marija was extremely knowledgeable, professional and helpful. Did my 2025 return and amended my 2024 return and got me a bigger refund. Was very thorough and helped me with my 1099 return. I definitely recommend them to anyone wanting to maximize their return.

Marija with E&N has helped me re-organize some of my more complicated clients account who have many moving parts to their businesses. Her attention to detail is incredible. She is reliable, communicative and such a great addition to anyone's financial team!

I’ve been working with Marjia for two years now, and I truly couldn’t recommend her more highly. She is incredibly knowledgeable, responsive, and reliable.

Marjia consistently brings thoughtful advice and takes the time to explain things clearly, which makes a huge difference. I always feel confident that everything is being handled thoroughly and correctly.

It’s rare to find someone who is not only technically excellent but also so easy to work with. I’m very grateful to have her and would highly recommend her to anyone looking for top tier work!

Marija has been incredible. Working with her has been transformative to my business and finances. Not only did she help me clean up my taxes from a previous CPA who had messed them up, she has helped me to create systems and structures to manage my taxes moving forward. Her services have more than paid for themselves through her in depth knowledge of the tax code, and Marija is the most reliable person I know. I wouldn't trust my tax returns to anyone else ever again. I HIGHLY recommend her.

Marija was extremely knowledgeable, thorough, and professional in walking us through our first small business return (as well as our usual married filing jointly personal return). We also got a significant refund thanks to her help in keeping our expenses carefully documented. Would strongly recommend!

As a small business owner, finding a partner who truly understands the complexities of New York State tax codes was my top priority. Since switching to E&N , the last few tax seasons have been night and day compared to my previous experiences. They handle the 'ins and outs' of state laws with total expertise. Seeing the thorough legwork they put in throughout the year gives me complete confidence when it’s time to file. If you want to take the stress out of year-end taxes, I can’t recommend them enough.

Amazing people work here.

Marija was very thorough, helpful and empathetic. Getting my taxes done was a breeze. They go out of there way for a client here. Beats doing the taxes yourself, treat yourself to a great service with these people that have fair / excellent pricing and thorough tax checks. Been with them 2024 and 2025 so far so great.

Thanks much, John C.

Marija has been a huge asset to our short term rental business and able to save us with her vast knowledge in the area. She has been doing our bookkeeping for that as well as personal taxes. She makes it easy to understand and is reasonable.

Thanks again!
Marija is the best!! She is professional, thorough, and a joy to work with. She is also very patient and helpful. She has been doing our taxes for a few years and does a great job!
I worked with Marija - she really knows her stuff and took the time to answer my questions!!   E&N Tax experience was great.

Marija is amazing. I’ve recommended her to friends and family because she’s reliable, knowledgeable, and always goes the extra mile. She makes something that can be so stressful much easier to handle. If you need a great tax accountant, Marija is the one to call.

“E & N delivers excellent tax preparation and tax strategy guidance. Professional, reliable, and truly focused on helping clients keep more of what they earn. I started using their services in 2023 and it has been second to none!”
I've never had a tax preparer who was this attentive and thorough. Marija gives you her full attention, answers every question, and clearly loves what she does. Highly recommend.
If you need help with your taxes Marija is the person to go with. She has been doing my taxes for years I can’t explain how helpful she is. Always explaining everything and answering all my questions

Marija has been handling my taxes for several years, and I can’t recommend her highly enough. She is extremely knowledgeable, detail-oriented, and consistently makes the entire process easy and stress-free. Her professionalism, responsiveness, and genuine care for her clients truly set her apart. I completely trust her with my taxes and wouldn’t go anywhere else. If you’re looking for someone exceptional, Marija is the one!
